d:
INDIA Bloc leaders have moved the Supreme Court seeking permission to submit a formal interrogatory of 48 questions to the Election Commission of India (ECI), including Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, and Deputy Election Commissioner Bhanu Prakash Yeturu, over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
Video Editor: Rahul
